summary: SCHMID Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K announcing a preliminary letter of intent and investment framework agreement to establish a new manufacturing campus in Zhongshan, China. The total expected investment is approximately €11 million ($11.8M) for land and construction, financed primarily through local bank loans secured by project assets. The facility aims to consolidate existing operations and double effective capacity, targeting mid-2027 operations. This is a routine organic expansion filing, not a special situation; no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event is involved.
